column1: # Source-owned histogram-free global TopN aggregation evidence.

column5: The Rust leaf ports the histogram-free portion of MergePartTopN2GlobalTopN from lines 145-209: skip empty partitions, sum equal encoded values with uint64 wrapping arithmetic, rank by count descending and encoded bytes ascending, then split the selected TopN from its remainder; histogram fallback/removal, Datum decoding, SQL-killer, concurrency, and storage remain external.
